who.value: seller promoting a listing with Spotlight

job.value: Set Spotlight's daily max clicks, duration and priority

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: 'Spotlight' with 'Set daily maximum', 'Set duration' and 'Prioritise' makes it a setup screen.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: The teal 'Next' with '15 per click' is the primary.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: Duration chips are clear, but 'Next' gives no hint of what follows and the 'Usual'–'High' slider doesn't say what priority changes.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: 'priority' and 'behind 261 other ads' need explaining; 'clicks' as the unit is not tied to cost on screen.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: It asks for a daily click cap and a 0–100% priority, which a seller can't judge without knowing what each costs or earns.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: All three settings, including the advanced priority bidding, are shown to everyone with no default path.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
Little reading needed to act
questions.why: Sliders carry it, but 'You're currently behind 261 other ads...' must be read to understand the priority slider.
